subject.title: fix(music): stop hanging when generated asset downloads drip forever

question: Should agents.defaults.musicGenerationModel.timeoutMs be treated as one total wall-clock budget across headers, retries, error diagnostics, and successful asset-body reads?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent and fixes the hang, but this interpretation can intentionally fail continuously progressing downloads that exceed the configured total budget, which is an upgrade-visible compatibility choice.

options.title: Adopt total operation deadline
options.body: Confirm the timeout as a total download budget and merge after rebasing and exact-head CI, accepting bounded failures for exceptionally slow progressing downloads.

options.title: Preserve separate body semantics
options.body: Require a revised design that keeps the existing timeout behavior and introduces an explicitly approved hard-body deadline without adding an unnecessary permanent config surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt total operation deadline
recommendation.body: Confirm the timeout as a total download budget and merge after rebasing and exact-head CI, accepting bounded failures for exceptionally slow progressing downloads.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent generated-media timeout and provider work makes this contributor the strongest available domain-routing candidate for the timeout contract decision.
